messages:
tamika_success: Heads-up: starting onboarding sync for Peregrine Labs today. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a 30/60/90 timeline. Can @alex_se, @maria_cs, @ryan_product, and @ops_bot confirm availability? :wave:

alex_se: Available 10-11am PT. Will bring integration checklist. Any pre-reads?

maria_cs: I have customer contacts: Sara (CTO), Miguel (ML eng), Priya (PM). Suggest intro call + shared doc. I'll drop invite.

tamika_success: Thanks. High-level success criteria I'm proposing:
1) Production inference traffic >= 50k tokens/day within 60 days
2) Avg p99 latency < 120ms on core route
3) Zero P1 incidents for first 30 days post-launch
4) Team trained on Redwood Console + Alerting
Thoughts?

ryan_product: Agree on criteria. Suggest adding a baseline quality threshold — e.g., eval suite pass rate >= 92% before go-live.

maria_cs: Noted. I'll own the eval set & feedback capture. Can we add a weekly triage slot for false positives/quality regressions?

alex_se: I'll own integration playbook + SDK snippets. For timeline, propose:
```
D0: Intro call + stakeholder mapping
D7: Integration POC
D30: Beta traffic + QA
D60: Production flip
D90: Post-mortem & cost tuning
```

tamika_success: Looks good. Are there renewal risk flags? Peregrine is on a 12-month contract, renewal in ~9 months. Current risk: moderate (latency concerns noted in pre-sales). We'll add a risk tracker.

maria_cs: Customer asked about Private deployment options for data residency. Marking that as an action item for Legal & Infra. @alex_se can you flag privacy/region reqs?

alex_se: Will confirm required regions and whether Private is necessary. Infra review could take ~2 weeks.

ops_bot: Calendar event created: 'Peregrine onboarding intro' Thu 2026-04-02 17:00 UTC. Invite sent to listed participants.

tamika_success: Action items:
- Maria: create shared onboarding doc + eval set
- Alex: integration playbook & infra privacy check
- Ryan: define quality gates + dashboard
- Tamika: schedule weekly triage + SLAs
I'll update doc and ping before intro. :rocket:

maria_cs: Added initial doc here: https://redwood.intranet/s/Peregrine-onboard. Please add notes.

alex_se: Added SDK snippet for auth flow. FYI had to update token rotation snippet.

ryan_product: I'll prepare eval baseline by EOW.

tamika_success: Perfect. If no objections, I'll send intro invite. Thanks all :smile:
